## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that solves it.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and any check that could not run.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped and contains no unrelated edits.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated where behavior changed.
- [ ] Lint, typecheck, tests, and build pass where applicable.
- [ ] Accessibility implications were reviewed, including keyboard and assistive-technology use.
- [ ] Documentation was updated where behavior or contributor workflow changed.
- [ ] Untrusted scan data remains safely handled and no sensitive data was added.
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes were discussed and reviewed appropriately.
